lines.en: - Stojna, hey Stojna the bride, lele,
lead the dance over to me, lele.

lines.cyr: Да ти го видам лицето, леле,
lines.lat: Da ti go vidam liceto, lele,
lines.en: Let me see your face, lele,
whether it is white or red, lele.

lines.cyr: - И да го видеш, фајде немаш, леле,
lines.lat: - I da go videš, fajde nemaš, lele,
lines.en: - Even if you see it, you gain nothing, lele,

lines.cyr: ти си си лудо женето, леле.
lines.lat: ti si si ludo ženeto, lele.
lines.en: you are a silly one, already wed, lele.

lines.cyr: Јас сум си, моме дадено, леле,
lines.lat: Jas sum si, mome dadeno, lele,
lines.en: - I am, girl, already given away, lele,
I have a little baby boy, lele.
